newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama construction firm seeks capital increase.
newsitem.headline: Panama construction firm seeks capital increase.

text.p: Panamanian construction company Unesa, among the country's top five, said it will offer 700,000 new shares in a bid to increase its capital by some $8 million over the next two years.

Unesa, Union Nacional de Empresas, went public Monday after issuing about 14 percent of the 700,000 common stock shares on Panama's Stock Exchange at an initial price of $12 per share, Vice President Guillermo Quijano said.
Founded in 1967, Unesa is diversifying into restaurant and hotel industries throughout Central America and Colombia, Quijano said.
Unesa has franchise agreements with Dallas-based TGI Friday's restaurants and Minneapolis-based Country Inns & Suites to build establishments in Panama, Guatemala, El Salvador and Colombia, he said.
